description: This file defines IPC message-related classes and templates, including ScalarType, Text, BufferType, and related typedefs, within the WPEFramework::Core::IPC namespace. It provides serialization, deserialization, and type handling functionalities for IPC communication.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Template class for handling scalar types with serialization support, specialized for string type.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Template class for fixed-length text handling with serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: BufferType
classes.description: Template class for managing byte buffers with serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for ScalarType and Text classes.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Getter and setter for ScalarType data.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the Text object.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into a byte buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte buffer into the object.
